gaps.explanation: Detail = budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis) for General (p9 total resources 15,013,017), Street (p10 6,728,750), Sales Tax (p11 11,299,817) + nonmajor combining Total column (p12 8,289,412) = 41,330,996. The statement (p4, GAAP modified accrual) prints General 14,640,430, Street 7,012,400, Sales Tax 11,358,527, Nonmajor 8,289,412, Total 41,300,769. Per fund: General 15,013,017 - 14,640,430 = +372,587; Street 6,728,750 - 7,012,400 = -283,650; Sales Tax 11,299,817 - 11,358,527 = -58,710; Nonmajor 0. Net +372,587 - 283,650 - 58,710 = +30,227 = schedule above statement. Every fund's budgetary actuals differ line by line from its GAAP column (e.g. General property 6,235,319 vs 6,311,195; Street intergovernmental 5,383,196 vs 5,756,525; Sales tax 10,406,740 vs 10,465,450), so the difference is the printed budgetary vs GAAP basis, not missing or duplicated lines. Nonmajor detail ties exactly.

Detail: General budget schedule (p9) 28,927,424 + Street (p10) 11,947,662 + Sales Tax (p11) 299,895 + nonmajor Total column (p12) 6,404,052 = 47,579,033.
